subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: The gate shall read its per-trigger severity map — which checks are blocking versus advisory at planning entry versus on contract-doc PRs — from a closed-schema, versioned policy artifact, such that changing a severity is a data change requiring no behavior-code change.
rationale: policy as data (AP-6/AP-10); the guardrail's demotion path (§3.3) is a data edit, and the default split (all hard at entry; coverage advisory continuously) is the seed
fit_criterion: an unknown policy key fails closed-parse; editing the map to demote a check to advisory flips a fixture's gate outcome with zero code diff; the default map encodes `#D-4`'s split
